notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to reconcile, in priority order. (1) The kit is a coherent machine: 'Re-enters Burst Stage 1' exists to produce the 4th burst cast that maxes Shopping (B1 + re-entered B1 + B2 + B3 = 4), which in turn opens the max-stack gate on the fullBurstEnd gauge buff. Tests that exercise skill2's gauge line in a comp where only 3 casts happen per chain — or that never verify the re-enter actually yields a second stage-1 cast — are asserting a state the faithful model cannot reach, and an UNGATED encoding would pass them; demand the paired positive (4 stacks → buff fires) AND negative (3 stacks → silent) assertions. (2) COMP HAZARD: rupee-winter-shopper is Burst I, and the standard control fixture already fixes liter into the B1 slot — the entire burst block (reload speed, re-enter, heal) is conditional on rupee WINNING the stage-1 selection in a two-B1 comp. Any test must first assert a burstCast event with rupee as caster exists at all; otherwise every burst assertion is vacuously green/red for selection reasons, not modeling reasons. (3) skill2a's trigger is any-ally-any-stage burst cast (stageEnter 1/2/3 or a cast-counting resource), not fullBurstEnter — the under-stacking misread. (4) Reload Speed ▲ is DAMAGE (shot-count gate), not skippable utility, and it is burstCast-keyed, not fullBurstEnter — assert both the buffApply-coincides-with-her-cast property and a real shot-count delta. (5) The self-heal's target set is the trap, not its magnitude: 'Affects self' means recovery events must reach only rupee; an allies-targeted heal silently feeds any on-recovery consumer in the fixture (crown) and moves damage. (6) All magnitudes (19.02 / 1.33×4 / 7.9 / 50.47 / 63.17) are kit-literal → DATAMINED; no ⚑ estimates are needed anywhere, so any calibrated-looking value in the override is a red flag.
